name: Watch
summary: A live picture of your whole agent fleet on its own rail page: every agent a body where it sounds, a figure for every action, their processes and network traffic, the relay's visitors, and a list of sounds that lights up as each one plays.

screenshots.alt: The Watch page: agents as glowing bodies on a dark field, hosts they talk to along the top, and the list of sounds down the side

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: See every agent run's events, status and usage as the desktop receives them
Read which hosts the agents' processes are connected to and how many bytes move
Show the desktop's log lines and background work beside the agents
Block a web visitor at Cloudflare's edge when you ask, with your Cloudflare API token
